newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Fed March index up 0.7 pct to record 126.7.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Fed March index up 0.7 pct to record 126.7.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago said on Monday its Midwest manufacturing index rose 0.7 percent in March to a record 126.7 from 125.8 in February.

"The regional steel and resource sectors grew at faster rates than the nation, while the auto and machinery sectors lagged the national performance," the Chicago Fed said, noting the Fed Board's industrial production index rose 0.9 percent in March.

"For the second consecutive month, all sectors in the Chicago Fed Midwest Manufacturing Index (CFMMI) posted monthly gains, with every sector at least 5.0 percent above year-ago levels," the Chicago Fed also said. "The last time all four sectors posted positive growth for two months in a row was five years ago."
